opportunities.name: Poison stride engine
opportunities.objective: Use amplified move bonuses to maintain poisoned Twin Fang range.
opportunities.mechanic: Primary Serpentine Grace amplifies movement bonuses and Q grants 30-50% decaying speed on a champion hit. Cosmic Drive triggers on magic damage; repeated poisoned Twin Fang gains an additional 0.45 AP damage and AP healing. Bloodletter rewards the sustained magic sequence, while Rod/Seraph address mana. Swiftness is conditional on the primary passive being authoritative.
opportunities.requiredState: Need maintained poison and legal boots access; replace boots with Visage if the helper restriction applies.
opportunities.failure: A missed Q removes both speed and enhanced E, and silence or mana pressure breaks the chase.
opportunities.test: Test boot purchase first, then E hits, healing and distance maintained during a moving poison duel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rylai or item burns are not poison merely because they deal damage over time.

opportunities.name: Miasma sustain bunker
opportunities.objective: Hold a grounded zone long enough for healing to matter.
opportunities.mechanic: Miasma persists five seconds, poisons and grounds enemies, permitting enhanced E without another Q hit. Liandry and Riftmaker reward continued magic combat; Visage increases received healing and health contributes to Riftmaker AP. Petrifying Gaze can extend the zone against facing targets, but turned enemies only receive the slow. Boots remain source-conflict dependent.
opportunities.requiredState: Need targets inside W, charged Tear and sufficient mana for repeated E casts.
opportunities.failure: Walking out, long-range poke and anti-heal can defeat the bunker before sustained effects mature.
opportunities.test: Compare ten-second mana use, healing and burn damage versus a mobile opponent; verify boots legality separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The separate Triumphant passive record cannot be assumed to grant free level AP or forbid boots live.

ruledOut.idea: Unconditional six-slot AP with no boots
ruledOut.reason: A helper says no boots, while the primary passive says move amplification; current legality is unresolved.

unknowns: Primary and Triumphant passive conflict on boots and AP; both routes require a live purchase check before recommendation.

builds.name: Poison stride engine
builds.summary: Use amplified move bonuses to maintain poisoned Twin Fang range.
builds.goal: Use amplified move bonuses to maintain poisoned Twin Fang range.
builds.hypothesis: Primary Serpentine Grace amplifies movement bonuses and Q grants 30-50% decaying speed on a champion hit. Cosmic Drive triggers on magic damage; repeated poisoned Twin Fang gains an additional 0.45 AP damage and AP healing. Bloodletter rewards the sustained magic sequence, while Rod/Seraph address mana. Swiftness is conditional on the primary passive being authoritative.
testPlan: Required state: Need maintained poison and legal boots access; replace boots with Visage if the helper restriction applies.
Test boot purchase first, then E hits, healing and distance maintained during a moving poison duel.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A missed Q removes both speed and enhanced E, and silence or mana pressure breaks the chase.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rylai or item burns are not poison merely because they deal damage over time.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Rod of Ages, Seraph's Embrace, Cosmic Drive, Bloodletter's Curse, Rabadon's Deathcap, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
